question: What is the meaning of life-cycle assessment (lca) in relation to certification and labeling?
description:
Life-cycle assessment (LCA) is a methodology used to analyze and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems over their life cycle. In relation to certification and labeling, LCA can be used to evaluate the environmental performance of products, helping to inform decisions on product development, improvement, and marketing. It can also be used in public policy making and strategic planning to assess the environmental impact of products and services. However, not all potential impacts can be assessed using an LCA, and the assessment of certain indicators may depend on the scope of the study or the availability of robust data and calculation methods. <|ENDINPUT>
